fusions.name: Gyotaku Print
fusions.desc: Slaps an inked sheet onto the first enemy it meets that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target are printed onto every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Silver Run
fusions.desc: Looses a shoal of 5 folded fish at once, spread apart; each deals 8 damage and slips past the target's armour entirely.

fusions.name: Oiled Vellum
fusions.desc: Coats you in slick waxed pages that raise your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick Margins
fusions.desc: Every blow you slip past adds a line to your margins, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per line (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a line fades every 6 seconds.
